Name: Eshcol
Summary: Eshcol was a brother of Mamre and a confederate of Abram in the hill country near Hebron.
KeyStory: Eshcol joined Abram's rescue of Lot, and Abram insisted Eshcol and his brothers keep their share of the recovered goods.
LifeLesson: Good neighbors matter: Eshcol stood with Abram when it counted.
